Human stdout mirrors and the outer Python traceback are not redistributed because they contain private runtime paths. Profile stdout hashes remain in execution-derived.json attempts raw_logs_sha256 and supervisor-outcome.json; the outer traceback hash is recorded in omitted_original_artifacts here. Structured results, full journals, native stderr and exception classification are retained.

Private path aliases are archive references, not executable installation paths. Exact evaluated source payloads are separately bundled with normalized archive metadata and a distinct public archive hash.
Input vectors and AI relevance judgments are external artifacts; the engine calculation observations do not guarantee semantic quality or certify a deployment.
This is a single native Mac quality/cost matrix, not a100k-scale, Linux/MSRV,2GiB,CI or whole-version acceptance result.
